name: Fabrication Specialties of Arkansas by Millar Partners
old_description: Our company is equipped to handle all your custom fabrication needs in stainless, carbon steel, and aluminum.
about:
Fabrication Specialties of Arkansas operates from Van Buren, Arkansas, as a division of Millar Partners, LLC. The company provides custom steel fabrication services for commercial and industrial clients from its facility at 1016 South 28th Street.

The shop handles structural steel fabrication including cambered beams, rolled members, metal pan stairs, columns, beams, and miscellaneous steel. It works with stainless steel, carbon steel, and aluminum, offering in-house machining, material processing, engineering, design and detailing, and structural steel erection for projects it fabricates. A CNC brake press supports forming operations.

The company serves commercial and industrial construction markets, with its welders and fabricators bringing over 50 years of combined experience to projects. It also accepts overflow fabrication packages from other shops that need additional capacity.

Fabrication Specialties of Arkansas emphasizes quality and service, partnering with customers during design and detailing to ensure fabricated work exceeds expectations.
